votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 09 of 2025, creating a Public Infrastructure District to facilitate financing the redevelopment of the Delta Center, Salt Palace, Abravanel Hall and UMOCA, and related projects to support public assets.
votes.description: Creates the Convention Center Public Infrastructure District to define the City's role and process in establishing the district, assisting with financing the redevelopment of the Delta Center, development of SEG's entertainment district, and redevelopment of the Salt Palace.
